senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כפף)to bend over, fold, double.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 63a:20">Ber. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>כּוֹפְלִין לו וכ׳</he> his means of support will be doubled to him.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 95:4">Gen. R. s. 95</cite>, end <he>כל מי שכ׳ שמו וכ׳</he> every one whose name the Scripture mentions twice in the blessings of Moses; (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92a:19">B. Kam. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>אותן שהוּכְפְּלוּ בשמות</he>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:11">Succ. III, 11</cite> … <he>מקום לִכְפּוֹל יִכְפּוֹל</he> where it is customary to recite twice (each verse of <cite ref="Psalms 118:21-29">Ps. CXVIII, 21—29</cite>), let one do so.

Tosef. Pes. X, 9 רבי היה כּוֹפֵל בה דברים Rabbi used to repeat certain words (in singing the Hallel); Pes. 119ᵇ; Succ. 39ᵃ מוסיף לכפול מאודך וכ׳ adds (to Rabbi’s repetitions) by doubling the verses from Od’kha (Ps. l. c.). Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, Par. 10, ch. XII; Men. VI, 4 (75ᵇ) כופל אחד וכ׳ (Bab. ed. קופל) he folds it twice over and breaks it (into four parts).
Gitt. 62ᵃ כּוֹפְלִין שלום וכ׳ we must double the greeting (say twice shalom) &c.

B. Mets. 104ᵇ לכפול וכ׳ where it is costumary to write out the K’thubah for double the amount of the dowry, half the amount is collected; a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּפוּל, f. כְּפוּלָה; pl. כְּפוּלִים, כְּפוּלִין; כְּפוּלוֹת.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 27:5">Kel. XXVII, 5</cite> <he>נמדד כ׳</he> is measured as it is doubled (folded).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 27:6">Ib. 6</cite>.—Ohol. XI, 3 <he>כ׳</he> Var. in R. S. a. l. (ed. <cite ref="S00001"><he>ק׳</he></cite>) folded up one above the other.
<cite ref="Nedarim 66b">Ned. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ הן</he> her ears are bent over (deformed).—

<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 2:11">Treat. Sof’rim II, 11</cite> <he>אותיות הכ׳</he> letters which have two forms <he>(מנצפך</he>); a. fr.—<he>תנאי כ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="V00719"><he>תְּנַאי</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be doubled. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ top נִכְפְּלוּ לו שניו his years of life were doubled to him.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 30">Gen. R. s. 30</cite>, beg.; Tanḥ. Sh’moth 18, a. e. <he>כל מי שנ׳ שמו</he> every one whose name appears twice in immediate succession (as Noah Noah, <cite ref="Genesis 6:9">Gen. VI, 9</cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be doubled, bent. Ib., v. קָפַל.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:2">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> (in a poetic eulogy) <he>קאת … הוּכְפְּלוּ לראות וכ׳</he> pelican and owl were bent upon looking (took pains to see, cmp. <cite ref="K01027">next w.</cite> Ithp.).—
B. Kam. 92ᵃ, v. supra.—Part. pass. מוּכְפָּל (Pu. מְכוּפָּל) doubly guarded, surrounded.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 557:1">Yalk. Lev. 557</cite> <he>מוכ׳ כמה כְפֵלוֹת</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>מכו׳ בכמה כפולות</he> (the tongue) is guarded by several folding doors (teeth, lips).

senses.gloss: to fold. Sifra l. c.; Men. l. c. לא היה מְכַפְּלָהּ (Bab. ed. מק׳) he did not fold it (in four parts, v. supra).
